newsitem.title: HONG KONG: NBC Asia says in China broadcasting deal.
newsitem.headline: NBC Asia says in China broadcasting deal.

text.p: NBC Asia, a unit of National Broadcasting Co of the United States, said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement to have its programmes distributed to hotels and foreign residential complexes in China.
In a statement, NBC Asia said 10,000 hotel rooms across China would receive business news channel CNBC and entertainment channel NBC at the launch of the service.
The agreement was signed with China International Television (CITV), the international arm of China Central Television, it said, adding that CITV saw growth potential of about 70,000 rooms.
NBC Asia said the deal had immediate effect, with the launch in individual hotels and residential complexes coming as soon as possible.
